lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Hey Byte! Clients keep saying ChatGPT recommended Prime Nest. Not us!

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: Because Prime Nest claimed their business. You didn't.

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: It's free. Since November tenth. Watch.

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: Step one. Log in, and open chatgpt.com/business-hub

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Do I need a paid plan?

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: Step two. Search your agency. Tap Get Started.

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: Step three. Prove it's yours. Business phone, email, website, or Shopify.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Can I use my personal email?

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: Use the one that matches your website.

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: Step four. A quick ID check, and you get the blue check.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: I look terrible in ID photos.

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: It's a check. Not a headshot.

lines.speaker: byte
lines.text: It doesn't buy a ranking. It gives ChatGPT your real details.

lines.speaker: marcus
lines.text: Byte, you just saved me a fortune.
